tp://fixture:8765/settings/billing\"", "aggregated_output": "> [!NOTE]\n>\n> **A per-trial token ceiling is not a spend control.**
It is set without seeing\n> what the suite normally uses, it is in a unit that is not comparable across\n> models, and it goes st
ale on every prompt or model change. `Token budget under\n> N` remains a valid assertion and keeps working wherever it is alread
y authored,\n> but for spend, two things replace it: [cost on every run](#cost), which shows\n> what a suite actually costs, and `
--max-cost-increase-percent`, which fails CI\n> when a change makes the suite more expensive relative to its own baseline. To\n> c

ap automatic credit purchases each month, see
> [auto-reload](https://docs.mcpjam.com/hosted/overview.md#auto-reload).

### Arg

ument matching

Tool-call argument comparison runs in one of three modes, configured at the suite:

* **partial** *(default)*:
every expected key must be present and match; extra keys in the actual call are ignored. Best for \"I care about `query` and `lim
it`, not what else the model put in.\"\n* **exact**: actual args must equal expected args, key-for-key.\n* **ignore**: only the to
ol name is checked.\n- [Self-hosted MCPJam](https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/self-hosted.md): Point the CLI and SDK at your organizatio
n's MCPJam server, lock it with an IT settings file, and work behind a corporate proxy\n- [Pay for one local eval iteration](https
://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/pay-for-one-local-eval-iteration.md): Collect the declared prompt fee and reserve one i
teration atomically before execution. Retries with the same identity reuse the receipt; changed requests conflict. Uploads claim t
he payment without charging again.\n- [Get one eval suite's configuration](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/get-one
-eval-suites-configuration.md): The suite's full settings: attached environments, hosts, execution config, judge, schedule. The li
st route returns run rollups instead; this is the shape the edit routes read and write.\n- [Update an eval suite's settings](https
://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/update-an-eval-suites-settings.md): Partial update: omitted fields are left as they are
. `environmentIds` is tri-state: a non-empty array sets/replaces, `null` clears (reverting the suite to legacy config), and `[]` i
s rejected rather than silently treated as a clear. Responds with the full updated suite.\n- [Author eval cases from a document](h
ttps://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/author-eval-cases-from-a-document.md): The sibling of `cases/generate`: generation
invents cases from the suite's tools, import reads them out of something a person already wrote: a test plan, a spreadsheet of sce
narios, a JSON export. MCPJam's own model turns the document into full cases (ordered steps, tool calls, assertions), so the c…\n-
[Mint a model lease for MCPJam-hosted inference](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/mint-a-model-lease-for-mcpjam-ho
sted-inference.md): How an SDK eval running OUTSIDE the platform (local dev, CI) uses MCPJam-hosted inference on the organization'
s credits, with no provider key of its own. Authenticate like any other `/api/v1` route (typically an `sk_` key).\n- [Authenticate
and record an eval start](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/authenticate-and-record-an-eval-start.md): Called by of
ficial SDK, CLI and Vitest runners before executing an eval. Requires an organization API key or saved-login bearer. Records only
start metadata, creates no dashboard run, and applies no debit or quota draw. Planned iterations are intent, not completed usage.
Reuse the runStartId for ret…\n- [Get a client](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/clients/get-a-client.md): One client's full
settings, including its resolved config, its `configId` (the concurrency token every write takes), and `impact`: what a config edi
t would follow. The path segment accepts a client **name or ID**. A client that exists but belongs to a different project reads as
`404 NOT_FOUND`.\n- [Replace a client's servers](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/clients/replace-a-clients-servers.md): Rep
laces the client's required and optional saved-server attachments without round-tripping the whole config. Composed server-side fr
om the client's current config, so every other setting is preserved, and `expectedConfigId` is required so two concurrent server r
eplacements cannot silently lose one.\n- [List a suite's settings history](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-suites/list-
a-suites-settings-history.md): One entry per committed edit to the suite's settings, newest first: who made it, which STORED field
s moved, the note they left, how many runs were launched against it, and the revision group that ties one request's writes togethe
r. Rows carry no configuration snapshots. Send a `revisionNumber` back…\n- [Create a project](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-referenc
e/projects/create-a-project.md): Creates a project in the caller's organization and responds `201` with its detail. Requires organ
ization membership and counts against the plan's `maxProjects` limit. Guest callers are denied.\n- [What the caller may do here](h
ttps://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/projects/what-the-caller-may-do-here.md): Role, gate state, plan limits and a set of derived
booleans, so an agent on a static surface can check before it acts instead of attempting a write and reading the failure.\n- [Get
a study](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/get-a-study.md): One study's full read: execution settings (model, system p
rompt, tool-approval policy, attached servers, share link), the environment it publishes, and the insights envelope over its lates
t analyzed window.\n- [Request insights for the current window](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/request-insights-for
-the-current-window.md): **No credits are consumed**: the model cost is on MCPJam. Runs a model over the study's current window an
d draws on the organization's `insightsPerDay` ledger, which counts REQUESTS and is SHARED with eval-run and swarm run insights, s
o a request here takes one from there.\n- [Request insights for an eval run](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/evals/request-i
nsights-for-an-eval-run.md): **No credits are consumed**: the model cost is on MCPJam. Runs a model over the finished run and draw
s on the same shared `insightsPerDay` request ledger as swarm and user-testing insights.\n{\"code\": \"NOT_FOUND\", \"message\": \
